bar.navigation.products.label: Products
bar.navigation.price-lists.label: Price lists
bar.navigation.outlets.label: Outlets
bar.screens.products.colour-help: Always shown beside the category's name, never on its own.
bar.screens.products.empty: Start with a category, such as Draught, Wine, Soft drinks or Snacks, then add the products in it.
bar.screens.products.name: Name
bar.screens.products.name-help: What a customer asks for, such as House lager or Programme.
bar.screens.products.first-size-help: Such as Pint or 175 ml. Leave it empty for a product sold in one size; more sizes can be added on its page.
bar.screens.products.standard-price-help: Leave it empty to set it later. A size with no price cannot be sold.
bar.screens.products.age-check-help: The till asks whether the customer looks under the challenge age before selling it.
bar.screens.product.size-name-help: Such as Pint, Half or 250 ml. A product sold in one size has one called Each, which the till does not show.
bar.screens.product.price-help-standard: Leave it empty to stop selling this size.
bar.screens.product.price-help: Leave it empty to take this size off the list. Where the list follows Standard, it then sells at Standard's price.
bar.screens.product.later: Start later, such as for a planned rise
bar.screens.product.price-saved: Price saved. Sales already rung up keep their price.
bar.screens.lists.standard: Standard: every other list starts from it
bar.screens.lists.by-hand-falls-back: Priced by hand, otherwise as Standard
bar.screens.lists.name: Name
bar.screens.lists.percent-off-help: Each price is Standard's less this, rounded to the nearest penny. It follows any change to Standard at once.
bar.screens.lists.falls-back: Use Standard's price where this list has none
bar.screens.lists.falls-back-help: Otherwise a size with no price on this list cannot be sold from it.
bar.screens.lists.restricted-help: Only people allowed to use restricted lists can choose it at the till, such as for committee prices.
bar.screens.lists.standard-help: Standard is the bar's ordinary prices. Set them on each product's page.
bar.screens.lists.percent-help: Every price here is Standard's less {percent}%, so it changes when Standard does.
bar.screens.lists.hand-help: Prices on this list are set on each product's page.
bar.screens.lists.unknown: There is no such price list.
bar.screens.outlets.empty: An outlet is a place that sells: the foyer bar, an interval kiosk, or the box office desk.
bar.screens.outlets.name: Name
bar.screens.outlets.name-help: Such as Foyer bar or Interval kiosk.
bar.screens.outlets.kind-help: One outlet can be the box office desk: drinks sold beside tickets come from it.
bar.screens.outlets.space-help: Optional. Shown on the Tonight screen.
bar.navigation.sell.label: Sell
bar.navigation.openings.label: Openings
bar.desk.label: Bar
bar.desk.no-outlet: There is no outlet to sell from. Someone who sets up the bar can add one under Outlets.
bar.desk.empty-menu: Nothing is on sale here yet: no product has a price on this outlet's list.
bar.desk.allergens.title: Allergens
bar.desk.allergens.help: Tap what the customer avoids. Then read them the statement below.
bar.desk.allergens.depends: Depends on what is picked: open it to see.
bar.desk.pick-size: Pick a size to add it.
bar.desk.choices.help: The usual choice is already picked.
bar.desk.refusal-carries-on: The age-restricted lines are off the sale. The rest carries on.
bar.desk.prompt.which-id: Asked for ID? Which one was shown
bar.desk.refusal.why: The reason you press is recorded in the register.
bar.desk.refusal.restricted-help: {names}. Everything else stays in the sale.
bar.desk.refusal.all-help: Everything comes off. Use this when they are leaving.
bar.screens.openings.empty: An outlet starts trading with its first sale in the till, and trades until someone closes it here.
bar.screens.openings.name: {outlet}, {day}
bar.screens.openings.close-plain: The next sale here opens it again.
bar.desk.prompt.title: Does the customer look under {age}?
bar.desk.refusal.description-help: Clothing, height, hair, apparent age. Do not write a name, or anything about race, religion, disability or health.
bar.screens.age-checks.description-page: Every age check the till asked and every refusal, for the premises licence. It records what staff did, never who the customer was.
bar.screens.age-checks.ages: Age-restricted products are sold to customers aged {minimum} or over. The till asks for ID from anyone who looks under {challenge}.
bar.screens.age-checks.erase-consequence: The words are removed for good. The row stays in the register.
bar.screens.age-checks.sign-help: Choose the days you have checked. The signature records how many refusals they cover.
bar.screens.age-checks.empty.title: Nothing in the register yet
bar.screens.age-checks.empty.description: The till adds a row here whenever it asks for an age check, and whenever a sale is refused. A licence usually expects a manager to sign it regularly.
bar.screens.sales.empty.title: No bar sales here
bar.screens.sales.empty.description: Sales made in the till appear here. Try clearing the filters.
bar.screens.sale.title: Bar sale {reference}
bar.screens.sale.refund-help: Choose what to refund. The money goes back the way it was paid; a refund over the limit is sent for a second person's approval.
bar.screens.sale.goodwill: Refund an amount instead, as goodwill
bar.navigation.sales.label: Bar sales
bar.screens.lists.raise.title: Raise prices
bar.screens.lists.raise.help: Every size priced on this list, or only those in the categories you choose, goes up together. Check the new prices before saving.
bar.screens.lists.raise.categories-help: Leave all unticked to raise every category.
bar.screens.outlets.layout-help: How this outlet's till shows its categories.
bar.screens.outlets.favourites-help: Pinned to the front of this outlet's till, in the order picked.
bar.screens.products.parent-help: Optional. Makes this a sub-category, such as Crisps under Snacks. One level only.
bar.screens.product.choices-help: Asked at the till when this is sold, in this order. Set the choices up under Choices.
bar.screens.product.mixer: Can be used as a mixer
bar.screens.product.mixer-tick: Can be used as a mixer
bar.screens.product.mixer-help: Adds a hidden Mixer measure size, so every Mixer choice offers this drink.
bar.screens.product.allergens-help: As the label says. The till never says a product is free from anything.
bar.screens.product.may-contain-help: Only what the label says it may contain, such as "made in a factory that handles nuts".
bar.screens.product.check-label-help: Tick what the label lists. Recording the same answer again counts as a fresh check.
bar.screens.product.sources.label: The product's label
bar.navigation.choices.label: Choices
bar.screens.choices.empty: A choice is a question the till asks when a product is sold, such as which spirit, which mixer or which milk. Set one up once and attach it to any number of products.
bar.screens.choices.sources.options-help: Such as the spirits for a spirit and mixer, or the milks for a coffee.
bar.screens.choices.sources.mixers-help: Lists every drink ticked "Can be used as a mixer" on its product page, by itself.
bar.screens.choices.pricing.fixed: A set amount for any mixer
bar.screens.choices.pricing.own_price: Each mixer at its own price
bar.screens.choices.no-mixers: No drink is ticked as a mixer yet. Tick "Can be used as a mixer" on a soft drink's page.
bar.screens.choices.name: Name
bar.screens.choices.name-help: The question's heading on the till, such as Spirit or Milk.
bar.screens.choices.required-help: The till takes the usual pick when the seller does not choose.
bar.screens.choices.default-help: Already picked on the till, so the common order is one tap.
bar.screens.choices.delta-help: Optional. Added to the size's price, such as 1.00 for a premium gin.
bar.screens.choices.option-age-help: Picking this asks the age check, even when the product does not.
bar.screens.choices.allergens-help: What this option brings to the drink it is picked for, as its label says. A mixer's allergens are on its product page.
bar.navigation.stock.label: Stock
bar.screens.choices.stock-item-help: What a recipe takes when this option is picked, by the amount the recipe gives. Leave it as none for an option such as "No ice".
bar.screens.outlets.stock-help: Each sale here takes its recipes from this location.
bar.screens.product.recipe-help: What selling one uses up. Pick a stock item, or one of this product's choices so the option picked supplies the item.
bar.screens.product.recipe-no-items: There are no stock items yet. Add them under Stock.
bar.screens.product.recipe-pick: Pick an item or a choice
bar.screens.stock.cost-help: What the last pack cost. Used only to value differences found at a stocktake.
bar.screens.stock.count-unit-help: How much is in the unit people count, such as 750 for a wine bottle. Left blank, it is one for each and the whole pack otherwise.
bar.screens.stock.empty: Add the kegs, bottles and cases you buy, then give each size a recipe on its product's page.
bar.screens.stock.items-help: How much each location holds. Stock never stops a sale, so a level can go below nought until it is counted.
bar.screens.stock.location-name-help: Such as Main bar or Cellar.
bar.screens.stock.locations-help: Where stock is kept. Each outlet takes its stock from one of them.
bar.screens.stock.name: Name
bar.screens.stock.name-help: Such as House lager 50 l keg.
bar.screens.stock.no-locations: No locations yet. Add one, then choose it on each outlet that takes from it.
bar.screens.stock.pack-name-help: Such as keg, case or bottle.
bar.screens.stock.pack-size-help: 24 for a case of cans, 50000 for a 50 l keg.
bar.screens.stock.place-help: A venue, or a space in one, so stock can be seen by place.
bar.screens.stock.reorder-help: Across every location. Below this it shows as low.
bar.screens.stock.unit-fixed: Fixed now that it has moved.
bar.screens.stock.unit-help: Each for cans and packets, ml for drinks poured, g for things weighed out.
bar.screens.stock.weighed: Can be weighed at a stocktake
bar.screens.stock.weighed-help: For a keg or an open bottle: the count is worked out from its weight.
bar.screens.products.category-age: Products here need an age check
bar.screens.products.category-age-help: Such as Wine, Beer and Spirits. A product can say otherwise on its own page.
bar.screens.products.usual-preset-help: Add a product opens straight on this preset for this category.
bar.screens.add-product.step-1: What kind of product? The preset fills in the sizes and choices.
bar.screens.add-product.sizes-help: One row each, with its Standard price. Percentage lists follow by themselves.
bar.screens.add-product.save-preset-help: Keeps the sizes, choices and settings for next time. Never the name or the prices.
bar.navigation.stock-levels.label: Stock
bar.navigation.deliveries.label: Deliveries
bar.screens.stock-levels.empty.title: No stock items yet
bar.screens.stock-levels.empty.descripti: Stock items and the places they are kept are set up in Admin, under the bar's Stock tab.
bar.screens.deliveries.location-help: The location the stock arrives at.
bar.screens.deliveries.supplier-help: Suppliers are added under Admin, Vocabularies, Bar suppliers.
bar.screens.deliveries.lines-help: Whole packs and any loose units. Give a pack cost only if the price has changed.
bar.screens.deliveries.empty.title: No deliveries yet
bar.screens.deliveries.empty.description: Record a delivery when stock arrives, and it is added to the location it goes to.
bar.screens.deliveries.discard-consequen: Nothing has arrived from it yet, so no stock changes.
bar.screens.deliveries.final: A received delivery is final. Put a mistake right with another delivery, by writing stock off, or at the next count.
bar.screens.stock.allergens-help: Tick what this item's label lists. Every size whose recipe uses the item, and every option that takes it, answers with it. Recording the same answer again counts as a fresh check.
bar.screens.product.allergens-from-stock: Sizes made from stock answer with the allergens of the items in their recipe. Check those labels on the Stock tab.
bar.screens.product.allergens-own: This product's own label: used by sizes with no recipe.
bar.navigation.stocktakes.label: Stocktakes
bar.screens.stocktakes.what-help: Everything in use, or one category and the categories under it.
bar.screens.stocktakes.empty.title: No counts yet
bar.screens.stocktakes.empty.description: Start a count at a location to check what is really there. Approving it puts the levels right.
bar.screens.stocktakes.title: Count of {what} at {location}
bar.screens.stocktakes.sent-back: Count sent back to be counted again.
bar.screens.stocktakes.abandon-consequen: No levels change. What was counted is kept as a record.
bar.screens.stocktakes.counting-help: Count what is there in the unit shown; a part is fine, such as 2.5. Weigh an open bottle instead if it has weights. Sales made while you count are allowed for when you submit.
bar.screens.stocktakes.counting-blind: Count what is there in the unit shown; a part is fine, such as 2.5. Weigh an open bottle instead if it has weights. The levels are hidden so the count is your own.
bar.screens.stocktakes.review-help: Give each difference a reason if you know it. Approving changes each level that differs, on top of anything sold since.
bar.screens.stocktakes.waiting: This count is waiting for someone who approves counts.
bar.screens.stocktakes.abandoned-note: This count was abandoned, so no levels changed.
bar.chart.title: Allergens at the bar
bar.chart.description: What each drink and snack contains, from its label. Ask at the bar if you are unsure.
bar.chart.not-found: There is no allergen chart to show.
bar.chart.incomplete: Some labels have not been checked yet. Those items say so: please ask at the bar about them.
bar.chart.avoid-help: Each item then says whether it contains or may contain any of them.
bar.chart.nothing: Nothing is on sale at the moment.
bar.chart.not-checked: Not checked: ask at the bar
bar.chart.footer: This chart lists the 14 allergens UK food law names, as the labels say. Nothing here means an item is free from an allergen: labels change, so please tell us about any allergy when you order.
bar.screens.deliveries.labels-due-help: These items have not had their label checked within the re-check period. Check them now, while the new stock is to hand.
bar.screens.allergen-card.unchecked.one: {count} size on sale has a label not checked yet
bar.screens.allergen-card.unchecked.othe: {count} sizes on sale have labels not checked yet
bar.screens.register-card.overdue.one: The refusals register has not been signed as checked for {count} day
bar.screens.register-card.overdue.other: The refusals register has not been signed as checked for {count} days
